items.title: Solstice Stock Jumps After Calling Off a Major Acquisition
items.summary: Shares of  Solstice Advanced Materials  soared early Friday after the company called off a dramatic acquisition that would have turned the company into even more of an AI play.  In early July, Solstice announced a cash and stock deal to buy  Element Solutions  Element makes products used in semiconductor manufacturing.  Together, the companies would supply three legs of the AI value chain: The chips, the data centers, and the power that makes everything work.
